background: Standard Chartered PLC is the London-listed holding company of a bank whose business is almost entirely in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, earning from corporate and institutional banking, trade finance and wealth management.
synthesis: As a holding company its ratings sit below the banks': A from Fitch and BBB+ from S&P on a positive outlook, with the last move Fitch's downgrade to A on 20 Sep 2018. Consolidated capital is mixed against UK majors: CET1 of 14.2% is in the top quarter against the peer median, while leverage of 4.7% is below the peer median. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 158% above the peer median and NSFR of 137% in the top quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is good, with a clean beat on 28 Jul 2026 and S&P's positive outlook on 23 Jul 2026.
